topic: understand how compound interest grows savings
core_question: How does compound interest work when growing my savings? (secondary: How do I get my wireless printer onto a new WiFi network?)
answer_summary: Each period, interest is calculated on the current balance (principal plus previously earned interest) rather than just the original deposit, so the balance grows faster over time — the earlier you start saving, the more time compounding has to work.; after the topic shift: On the printer's touchscreen/control panel, open Network/WiFi Setup Wizard, select the new SSID, and enter the password to reconnect.
persona: skeptical and testy; writing terse one-liners
